title: Power zero-density bounds: chart companion
conventions: N(sigma,T) is the full zeta zero count with analytic multiplicity, both signs |Im rho|<=T and 0<Re rho<1. Every main row is a full-density theorem for all real T>=2.
Every epsilon>0 allows the bound N(sigma,T)<=C*T^(p(sigma)+epsilon). Unless p is printed directly, p(sigma)=A(sigma)*(1-sigma). In formulas s means sigma.

Square brackets include endpoints; round brackets exclude them. Rows give full verified source-theorem ranges. Earlier graphic junctions may close by the equal-valued adjacent theorem; graphic endpoint flags remain in the structured mapping.

Verified means the exact row conclusion has a completed Lean proof and recorded kernel verification. This does not claim every original historical analytic route was reimplemented. Component rows are verified only for their stated different objects.

The current, previously announced, and prior published plots share source rows. Repeated stage appearances are consolidated; every active plot segment and full support piece remains mapped in the JSON. Overlapping ranges are intentional.

component_rows.label: Polynomial count at sigma=17/20
component_rows.object_scope: component only; not a full-density estimate
component_rows.domain: sigma=17/20; CLOSED T^(1565/2936)<=N<=T^(4695/5872); all real T>=2, arbitrary coefficients bounded by 1, arbitrary translates and one-separated samples with polynomial modulus>=N^(17/20). This is a polynomial theorem, not a full zero count.

component_rows.label: Canonical long-zero subset on compact sigma intervals
component_rows.object_scope: component only; not a full-density estimate
component_rows.domain: For every closed [L,U] strictly inside (2243/2904,3301/4228), one delta(U)>0 is chosen before eta,epsilon,sigma,T; C before all sigma in [L,U] and all real T>=2. In particular [7/9,1561/2000] is closed. Analytic multiplicities retained.

component_rows.label: Canonical short-zero subset at sigma=17/20
component_rows.object_scope: component only; not a full-density estimate
component_rows.domain: sigma=17/20, detector exponent a=1565/2936; eta(epsilon)=min(1/16384,epsilon/2404) before each fixed smoothing delta; C before all T>=2. SHORT means membership in the original admissible normalized powered-polynomial family; LONG is its exact complement.
